critical_code_review_comments: RentalDetails BaseModel cleanly extended with new fields; all Optional with sensible defaults. category-specific validation is enforced client-side (nulls sent for irrelevant fields) which is acceptable.
HistoryTab defensive client-side DESC sort (backend also sorts) — good redundancy for Bug 24c.
VehicleActionsRow uses correct guards (isActive && !hasActiveListing for sell) — matches spec.
PlateBlurDialog: canvas.getContext('2d') at end of upload() only to appease linter is a smell — could be removed or replaced with `void canvas;` to make intent explicit.
Sidebar GROUPS array uses `group.key.split('.').pop()` for testids — works but tightly couples i18n key structure to testid. Consider adding explicit `slug` per group.
CreateListing.js is ~1048 lines — approaching the 700-line refactor threshold. Consider splitting rental-car / rental-garage / service sections into subcomponents next iteration.
